Mortality and morbidity prediction is a difficult issue for physicians, and various scoring systems have been developed. One of these scoring systems is the hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocyte and, platelet (HALP) score, which is a composite score used to assess the nutritional and immune status of a patient. It is considered a prognostic indicator and has been used to predict overall survival and other outcomes in various cancers and non-cancer diseases [2–6].
